body:
**Actions and Stuff on Lagva!!! Its port of A  S on Java Minecraft!**

Certainly! Here is the description for your Minecraft Java Edition mod, based on the Actions and Stuff Bedrock add-on, translated into English.

💎 Actions and Stuff (Java Port)
🚀 Reimagining Bedrock Combat Mechanics on Java!
Have you ever missed the more dynamic and engaging combat of Minecraft Bedrock while playing the Java Edition?

Actions and Stuff (Java Port) is a modification that brings the iconic Bedrock add-on of the same name to Java Edition, preserving and enhancing its unique mechanics. This mod introduces an entirely new set of movements, attacks, and actions, making PvP, PvE, and general movement far more spectacular and fun!

✨ Key Features of the Mod:
The Roll: The classic Bedrock add-on mechanic is now on Java! Use a dedicated key to perform a quick roll that allows you to dodge attacks and rapidly change your position in combat. It's the perfect way to avoid arrows or a critical blow.

Power Strikes: Adds new, more impactful animations and sounds for critical hits and sprinting attacks, meticulously recreating the feeling of power from the Bedrock experience.

Combo System: Implementation of mechanics that reward sequences of actions. Use the roll just before an attack to gain a temporary bonus to damage or speed.

New Player Animations: Modified running, jumping, and fighting animations to look smoother and better align with the Bedrock style (but adapted for the Java aesthetic).

Fresh Combat Dynamics: The mod aims to shift the focus from timed clicking to tactical positioning and the effective use of special movements, just like the original Bedrock implementation.

⚙️ Porting Details
For those interested in the technical side:

This port was carefully developed to reproduce the exact timing and hitboxes of the Bedrock mechanics using the capabilities of the Java API. We are not just changing animations; we are rewriting the core combat logic to ensure the roll is a functional and useful tool for damage avoidance, true to the original add-on.

💡 Why Should You Install It?
If you are looking for a way to breathe new life into Minecraft Java, add speed, tactics, and dynamism to your battles, or simply want the Java Edition combat to be as intuitive as it is in Bedrock—Actions and Stuff (Java Port) is made for you!
